title: Desk Authority on a Crop Input Purchasing Account: Limits, Terms, Acres, Security Interest and Review
content:
**Limit increases at the counter.** A limit may be raised at the counter by no more than the programme's one-step percentage of the existing limit, and only where the programme does not require a fresh review for an increase; anything larger, and every increase on a programme that does require it, goes to the credit department and waits for their recorded decision. The judgement is made before the change, on the cooperative's own record of the account — its credit standing, the limit it carries, the date of its last credit review and its reference number.

**The programme ceiling.** The limit may never be raised above the programme's ceiling at all, which is a board matter rather than a credit one.

**Terms.** Terms are a property of the programme and are not rewritten on a live account; a member who needs different terms moves programme, which means a fresh application.

**Enrolled acres.** Enrolled acres are rewritten on the member's own statement because they are the member's own fact, and the acres decide whether a programme rebate is earned at the end of the season. The account must be live for this — active, past due or suspended — and the acres are taken from the member together with the cooperative's own record of the account.

**Security interest.** A perfected security interest is recorded only from the filing itself, never from the member's account of it.

**Review.** A review is recorded when credit completes it, and an account whose review is older than the programme's review interval is not suspended for that reason alone but is not given an increase until the review is refreshed.

## Where the authority sits

| The change asked for | Where it is settled |
| --- | --- |
| An increase within the programme's one-step percentage, on a programme that does not require a fresh review | At the counter |
| An increase beyond that percentage | The credit department, on its recorded decision |
| Any increase on a programme that requires a fresh review | The credit department, on its recorded decision |
| An increase above the programme's ceiling | Not made at all; the ceiling is a board matter |
| Different terms on a live account | Not rewritten; a move of programme and a fresh application |
| A change of enrolled acres | Taken on the member's own statement |
| A security interest said to be filed | Recorded only from the filing itself |
| An increase where the last review is older than the programme's review interval | Not given until the review is refreshed |

The one-step percentage, whether an increase requires a fresh review, the programme ceiling and the review interval are each the figure the member's programme carries in the tables for the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.
